typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		AGILITY_ID as string,
		CONTACT_ID as string,
		CNX_FAMILY_ID as string,
		HESTIA_PLAN_ID as string,
		EFFECTIVE_DATE as string,
		EVENT as string,
		EVENT_DATE as string,
		EVENT_SOURCE as string,
		EVENT_OUTCOME as string,
		FRST_NM as string,
		MID_INIT_TXT as string,
		LAST_NM as string,
		ADDR_LN1_TXT as string,
		ADDR_LN2_TXT as string,
		CITY_NM as string,
		ST_CD as string,
		ZIP_CD as string,
		ZIP4_CD as string,
		HOME_PHN_NBR as string,
		BUSN_PHN_NBR as string,
		MOBL_PHN_NBR as string,
		FAX_NBR as string,
		EMAIL_ADDR_TXT as string,
		ACCT_ROLE_CD as string,
		BIRTH_DT as string,
		GNDR_CD as string,
		DO_NOT_CALL_IND as string,
		DO_NOT_SLCT_IND as string,
		DO_NOT_EMAIL_IND as string,
		DO_NOT_MAIL_IND as string,
		EXTRACT_DATE as string,
		MRN as string,
		PLAN_DSC as string,
		HOUSEHOLD_SIZE as string,
		HOUSEHOLD_INCOME as string,
		GRANDFATHERED_PLAN as string,
		FILE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/ib_lead_update*']) ~> source1
source1 derive(ADFId__c = uuid()) ~> addADFId
addADFId split(isNull(AGILITY_ID)||isNull(EVENT),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(RejectCondition, toSFDC)
ConditionalSplit1@RejectCondition derive(REJECT_REASON = iif(isNull(AGILITY_ID)||isNull(EVENT), concat('ADF:REQUIRED FIELD MISSING: ', iif(isNull(AGILITY_ID), 'AGILITY_ID ', ''),  iif(isNull(EVENT), 'EVENT ', '')), '')) ~> RejectReason
RejectReason select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
ConditionalSplit1@toSFDC derive(EFFECTIVE_DATE = iifNull(toString(toDate(EFFECTIVE_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd')), EFFECTIVE_DATE),
		EVENT_DATE = iifNull(toString(toDate(EVENT_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd')), EVENT_DATE),
		EXTRACT_DATE = iifNull(toString(toDate(EXTRACT_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd')), EXTRACT_DATE),
		DO_NOT_CALL_IND = toBoolean(DO_NOT_CALL_IND),
		DO_NOT_SLCT_IND = toBoolean(DO_NOT_SLCT_IND),
		DO_NOT_EMAIL_IND = toBoolean(DO_NOT_EMAIL_IND),
		DO_NOT_MAIL_IND = toBoolean(DO_NOT_MAIL_IND)) ~> DerivedColumn2
DerivedColumn2 select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Agility_ID__c = AGILITY_ID,
		Contact_ID__c = CONTACT_ID,
		CNX_Family_ID__c = CNX_FAMILY_ID,
		Hestia_Plan_Id__c = HESTIA_PLAN_ID,
		Effective_Date__c = EFFECTIVE_DATE,
		Event__c = EVENT,
		Event_Date__c = EVENT_DATE,
		Event_Source__c = EVENT_SOURCE,
		Event_Outcome__c = EVENT_OUTCOME,
		First_Name__c = FRST_NM,
		Middle_Name__c = MID_INIT_TXT,
		Last_Name__c = LAST_NM,
		Address1__c = ADDR_LN1_TXT,
		Address2__c = ADDR_LN2_TXT,
		City__c = CITY_NM,
		State__c = ST_CD,
		Zip__c = ZIP_CD,
		Zip_Plus_4__c = ZIP4_CD,
		Home_Phone__c = HOME_PHN_NBR,
		Work_Phone__c = BUSN_PHN_NBR,
		Cell_Phone__c = MOBL_PHN_NBR,
		Fax__c = FAX_NBR,
		Email__c = EMAIL_ADDR_TXT,
		Role_Code__c = ACCT_ROLE_CD,
		Date_of_Birth__c = BIRTH_DT,
		Gender__c = GNDR_CD,
		Do_Not_Call_Ind__c = DO_NOT_CALL_IND,
		Do_Not_Contact_Ind__c = DO_NOT_SLCT_IND,
		Do_Not_Email_Ind__c = DO_NOT_EMAIL_IND,
		Do_Not_Mail_Ind__c = DO_NOT_MAIL_IND,
		Extract_Date__c = EXTRACT_DATE,
		MRN__c = MRN,
		Plan_Name__c = PLAN_DSC,
		Household_Size__c = HOUSEHOLD_SIZE,
		Household_Income__c = HOUSEHOLD_INCOME,
		grandfathered_Plan__c = GRANDFATHERED_PLAN
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select2
addADFId sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('ib_lead_update_raw.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> IntremOutput
Select1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('ib_lead_update_source_reject.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> RejectOutput
Select2 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('ib_lead_update_Stage_Policy_Status__c.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> MapLeadOutput
